selected_gaps.gap: (additive; leaf sites L_deltamodel, L_restgp, L_concrete_residual) No residual-correction leaf provides a correction whose expected effect is non-negative where local reference evidence is thin. The Δ-model leaf finds corrections are needed most exactly where training coverage is sparsest, but it relies on acquiring new labels there. The residual-GP and physics-residual leaves say nothing about what their correction does to a query with no close training analogue. A fixed offline benchmark offers no label acquisition, so the question is open in exactly the regime where it matters. — stakes: on steels (n = 312) a handful of atypical alloys dominate MAE, so a correction that extrapolates wrongly there erases or reverses the average gain. In discovery use, the novel compositions are the ones whose predictions are acted on, so a correction that is harmful off-support costs real experiments.

companion_dependency.object: deployment-matched correction instances: for each inner-held-out training composition i, the tuple (pair-excluded analogue estimate A_i, competing base prediction f^(-m(i))(x_i), support descriptor s_i, label y_i)
companion_dependency.producer: the assumption pivot: re-specifying the correction's observation model so that the query's base prediction, every borrowed neighbour residual and the transfer model all come from refits that saw neither the query nor that neighbour (pair-excluded refits inside the training fold)
companion_dependency.consumer: fitting of the damping map lambda(s) and selection of the kernel bandwidth h, neighbourhood size k_nn and distance rho, by minimising the realised loss of (1 - lambda) f + lambda A on those instances
companion_dependency.removal_effect: without the manufactured instances lambda must be set by a variance or distance formula (partial pooling or an applicability-domain cut-off), which is the flagged C_shrinkage / C_applicability_domain node and is blind to the near-duplicate double-counting failure the pivot exposes

selected_gaps.companion_rationale: Step 2a chain A -> O -> B: the assumption pivot (A) replaces the tacit premise 'a neighbour's out-of-fold residual is exchangeable with the deployed stack's residual at the query' by a fold-matched transfer, and its construction yields O, a set of training-fold instances whose base prediction and borrowed residuals stand in exactly the fold relation that an outer test composition will; the signal-manufacturing move (B) consumes O as a label-free-at-deployment supervisory target for the damping map, which is the only way to learn where the correction helps when, offline, no new labels can be acquired where support is thin.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This is the construction gap whose closure the user's pipeline depends on: a local out-of-fold residual correction is only worth adding to a cross-fitted stack if its expected effect is non-negative where evidence is thin, and at n = 312 with no label acquisition that property must be built, not hoped for. The audit-and-pivot move closes it by naming the load-bearing premise the naive correction rests on (borrowed out-of-fold residuals are exchangeable with the refit stack's residual at the query, which fails where the refit has absorbed a near-duplicate neighbour) and building the correction under the relaxed premise; OCCUPIED-SOURCE CONSTRAINT for Phase 2.2: the residual-on-input transfer (n_residual_on_input, C_local_smoothing), distance damping (C_applicability_domain), variance shrinkage (C_shrinkage) and per-query expert weighting (C_moe, C_des) are occupied nodes and may appear only as substrate, so the novelty must come from the fold-relation mismatch between deployed refit and borrowed residual, which no lineage node occupies; heterogeneous_decomposition (partition queries by support regime) and adapt_via_conditioning (neighbour context at inference) were rejected because their natural artifacts land on C_applicability_domain and L_iclfm respectively.

deliverable_coverage: method — anchor gap -> assumption_audit_and_pivot defines the runnable fold-matched local residual correction; the Step 2a companion self_supervised_signal_engineering manufactures the deployment-matched instances on which its damping is fit, which together make the correction's in-fold expected effect non-negative by construction of the admissible family (lambda = 0 admissible).

user_direction_disposition.user_wanted: Transfer cross-fitted stacking of diverse experts followed by a novelty-damped local out-of-fold residual correction (confirmed in my earlier SIG-Net paper) to composition-based materials property prediction on the four Matbench v0.1 composition tasks (steels, expt_gap, expt_is_metal, glass)
quoted_spans_from_user_query: followed by a novelty-damped local out-of-fold residual correction (confirmed in my earlier SIG-Net paper)
the four Matbench v0.1 composition tasks (steels, expt_gap, expt_is_metal, glass)
Constraints: CPU-only, official Matbench folds, honest nested cross-validation for every choice, no test-fold use.
user_direction_disposition.chosen: The candidate keeps the user's pipeline shape and constraints: a cross-fitted stack of diverse CPU-trainable experts, then a damped local out-of-fold residual correction, every choice made by nested CV inside the official training folds. It modifies two internals of the correction. (1) The borrowed residual is fold-matched: it is added to the prediction of the refit that excluded the neighbour, not to the full refit. (2) The damping is not a fixed novelty (distance) schedule; it is a map over support descriptors fit on deployment-matched instances manufactured inside the training fold.
user_direction_disposition.why_adopted: The anchor gap (non-negative correction where local evidence is thin, offline) is exactly the property the user's correction stage needs on these tasks, so selecting it on the usual criteria lands on the user's direction rather than away from it. The direction is not transferred unchanged, because the regression map in method_lineage notes that stacking, local residual transfer and novelty damping each already occupy a node. The publishable increment is therefore the fold-relation fix and the manufactured damping signal. It is not the transfer of SIG-Net's components to a new domain, and SIG-Net is treated as the user's origin of the pipeline, not as indexed prior art.

composition_note: Anchor-only selection with one Step 2a chain companion; the five remaining gaps are deferred, and their measurements (error-structure stratification, selection variance, hard-label versus probability scoring, near-neighbour dependence) appear only as arms or strata inside falsification_prediction.

deferred_gaps.gap: (additive; leaf sites L_mattervial, L_iclfm, L_ecsg) No retrieved leaf on these tasks establishes whether the out-of-fold errors of the leading global composition predictors (feature-fused MODNet, TabPFN in-context prediction) or of a globally weighted stack are exchangeable across composition space or concentrated in identifiable chemical neighbourhoods, nor whether the experts' relative accuracy reverses between neighbourhoods. The amount of residual signal that any post-hoc stage could recover on steels, expt_gap, expt_is_metal and glass is therefore unknown. — stakes: a practitioner building a multi-expert pipeline cannot tell beforehand whether a second stage can help at all on a given task, so CPU-weeks are spent on stages whose ceiling may be zero. Intellectually, the field's choice of a single global model as the reporting unit rests on an untested premise about where error lives.
deferred_gaps.reason: fails removal test for a method: it asks for a measurement of error structure; the anchor stands without it, and its measurement becomes the support-stratified error arm of falsification_prediction

deferred_gaps.gap: (additive; leaf sites L_mattervial, L_ecsg, L_leakfree_stack) No leaf on the small composition tasks reports whether its selected configuration's gain exceeds the variance introduced by selecting that configuration on the same few folds. MatterVial's steels improvement (87.76 to 85.12 MAE) and its unreplicated glass 0.960 both sit in a range where fold-to-fold noise plus choosing among many feature-group/stack variants can produce the difference. Leakage-free out-of-fold construction removes one bias but not this selection variance. — stakes: leaderboard 'wins' on steels and glass may be winner's-curse artefacts that a reviewer at Computational Materials Science cannot tell apart from real improvements. Any paper, including the user's, that claims a per-task SOTA from a few-percent gain at n = 312 risks a non-replicating headline, which conflicts directly with an honest-results commitment.
deferred_gaps.reason: evaluation-only for a method contribution (Phase 2.1 hard rule); handled as a reporting requirement of the falsification campaign, not as a mechanism leg

deferred_gaps.gap: (additive; leaf site L_mattervial, inherited from the Matbench classification protocol) No leaf makes the classification scores on expt_is_metal and glass commensurable. Leaderboard 'rocauc' equals balanced accuracy for most entries (hard-label submissions), while MatterVial reports a probability AUROC of 0.976 against a board leader of 0.9598. It is therefore unknown which reported gains reflect better ranking and which reflect thresholding, and a combination stage that improves probability ranking can look either invisible or inflated depending on the submission format. — stakes: cross-entry SOTA comparisons on the two classification tasks are currently invalid as stated, and a CMS paper that compares a probability AUROC with the board's hard-label numbers would overclaim by about 0.02 AUROC from the metric alone. That is the kind of error a reviewer who knows the leaderboard will catch.
deferred_gaps.reason: scoring-protocol question, evaluation-only for this method; the candidate reports probability AUROC and in-fold-thresholded balanced accuracy separately inside falsification_prediction

deferred_gaps.gap: (subtractive; shared ancestor n_matbench_protocol: every leaf is evaluated under random 5-fold splits of redundant composition data) No retrieved paper tests whether improvements measured under the official random 5-fold splits depend on test compositions having near-neighbour or near-duplicate training compositions, that is, whether the random-split protocol is a valid estimator of the generalization that the improvement claims. — stakes: intellectually, published Matbench composition rankings, and especially any gain that borrows strength from nearby training points, may not transfer to novel chemistries (the physical-encoding leaf shows the in-distribution/out-of-distribution gap is real for these model families). Practically, a screening user who trusts a locally obtained leaderboard gain would carry it into exactly the out-of-support regime where it is least likely to hold.
deferred_gaps.reason: a protocol-validity diagnostic and an independently publishable second problem; its nearest-neighbour-distance stratification is reused as the stratum variable of the falsification, not as a mechanism leg

deferred_gaps.gap: (subtractive; shared ancestor n_global_erm / n_stacking: every leaf fits one global predictor or one globally fixed combination rule per task) Every retrieved leaf on composition tasks assumes that one fit per task, with the same parameters or weights for every composition, is the right predictive unit. This covers feature fusion into one MODNet, a single TabPFN context, and a meta-learner with one weight vector (ECSG, the leakage-free stack), as well as CORE-STACK+, whose per-sample gate is only demonstrated on large vision pools. No retrieved paper tests whether this homogeneity assumption is necessary for small, chemically clustered composition datasets rather than simply assumed. — stakes: intellectually, if the assumption fails, the leaderboard compares architectures on a quantity (one global fit) that hides where each method is actually reliable, and conclusions such as 'feature-based beats GNN on small sets' could be artefacts of averaging over heterogeneous neighbourhoods. Practically, users pick one 'best' model per property and inherit its worst-neighbourhood errors.
deferred_gaps.reason: its natural construction (input-dependent expert weights) lands on the flagged C_moe / C_des nodes; the anchor keeps one global stack and acts only on its residual, so this gap is future work
